attach_open_vroid.name: attach_open_vroid
attach_open_vroid.description:
Attach to a user-opened VRoid process without closing it on detach.

Edits act on that real session, including its unsaved model. If the MCP
copy is running, explicitly set discard_copy_unsaved after saving it.
Multiple candidate processes require a PID. Other MCP labs are excluded.
Attached mode does not load the lab isolation guard. Save character files
in VRoid itself; custom item saves use the target window's profile.

detach_open_vroid.name: detach_open_vroid
detach_open_vroid.description: Detach from the user-opened VRoid without closing its process or saving it.

restart_session.name: restart_session
restart_session.description:
Recreate only this MCP-owned VRoid copy, discarding its unsaved changes.

Requires explicit discard_unsaved=true. Save first when you can; this is not
a way to silently drop a user's work. The new model token invalidates every
id issued before it. It also recovers from COPY_DISCONNECTED or an uncertain
native call, and other VRoid processes are never touched.

get_status.name: get_status
get_status.description:
Report the copy, current model, background work and model update state.

The response also carries tool_count and toolset_hash, so a client that
cached an older tool list can tell whether it needs to reload instead of
guessing.

get_attached_state.name: get_attached_state
get_attached_state.description:
Inspect the attached window and any interrupted edit, producing a fresh recovery token.

Inspect parameters, layers and created files before acknowledging an
interrupted operation. This never retries or reverses the operation.
Dialogs, import tasks, VRM export and registered-item loading/selection
must finish before review. If their original agent was lost, process
exit may be the only available proof that native work has stopped.

acknowledge_attached_state.name: acknowledge_attached_state
acknowledge_attached_state.description:
Resume attached edits after reviewing the actual state and interrupted tool.

Use the fresh token from get_attached_state. A changed model, history,
file association or busy state invalidates it. No operation is replayed.

get_wear_status.name: get_wear_status
get_wear_status.description:
Report whether Dress-up is active, plus the wear token, item ids, mesh names, fit values and animation state.

Take the returned wear_token as expected_wear for every other Dress-up
call. A model token from ordinary editing does not identify an assembly.

open_wear_project.name: open_wear_project
open_wear_project.description:
Open a .vroid base or .xroid assembly in Dress-up.

Attached sessions accept absolute input paths; plain filenames and copy
sessions use this lab's saves/ directory.

This replaces whatever the disposable copy currently holds, so it requires
discard_unsaved=true. Returns a new wear token and the native items once
the load task has finished.

open_current_in_wear.name: open_current_in_wear
open_current_in_wear.description:
Save the current character to a new .vroid and open that copy in Dress-up.

Requires switch_to_wear=true. This changes screens and replaces the
current edit session after saving; close any active texture canvas first.
The original associated file is not overwritten. If the transition fails,
inspect the window and the named saved file before attempting anything else.

get_wear_snapshot.name: get_wear_snapshot
get_wear_snapshot.description:
Read the instantiated assembly: item renderers, texture sizes, skin bones and VRM spring components.

Requires a fresh wear token and a stopped preview. Presence of a component
says nothing about visual fit or simulated motion.

inspect_wear_body_occlusion.name: inspect_wear_body_occlusion
inspect_wear_body_occlusion.description:
Read the native Body active-vertex marks together with their identity hash.

Indices always address the original default Body mesh, never a compacted
posed mesh, so capture a matching reference before writing. This is a
read: it does not decide which anatomy should be hidden.

set_wear_body_occlusion.name: set_wear_body_occlusion
set_wear_body_occlusion.description:
Replace the hidden-vertex marks on the Dress-up copy's Body mesh.

Needs the token from a fresh inspection, sorted distinct original-mesh
indices, and stays within 2048 vertices or 20 percent. Pass an empty list
to restore the default Body. The native mesh history records the change;
the .vroid source and the garments are untouched. Save/reopen, seams,
animation and VRM export each need their own check, and a stale token or
an uncertain write stops the call.

inspect_wear_native_shoes.name: inspect_wear_native_shoes
inspect_wear_native_shoes.description:
Find the separate native shoe-only Cloth renderer and read its saved visibility marks.

Mixed clothing materials are rejected: only a renderer whose materials are
all native shoes qualifies.

set_wear_native_shoes_visible.name: set_wear_native_shoes_visible
set_wear_native_shoes_visible.description:
Show or hide only the native shoe surface through persistent mesh marks.

Body Foot geometry and the imported XWear stay as they are; save/reopen is
a separate check.

export_wear_vrm.name: export_wear_vrm
export_wear_vrm.description:
Export the actual Dress-up assembly as a new self-contained VRM 1.0 file.

Stop the preview and restore the default clip first. The destination is a
filename under this lab's saves/ and is never overwritten; title and author
are required. Metadata keeps the native restrictive defaults (author,
noncommercial, no redistribution or modification), so releasing the result
is a separate licensing decision. Completion, embedded resources, skins and
spring references are checked before publication. A valid file does not
certify visual fit, collision behaviour or a Godot import.

capture_wear_review.name: capture_wear_review
capture_wear_review.description:
Capture 1-6 assembled Dress-up views and save a snapshot manifest.

Views are either the legacy front/side/back/three_quarter set or
REGION_ANGLE, where REGION is body/face/head/upper/legs/feet and ANGLE is
front/back/left/right/three_quarter_left/three_quarter_right. Left and
right are observer sides seen from the front, and one batch shares the
measured bounds. Stop the preview and pass a fresh wear token. The images
come back inline; look at them before judging appearance or fit.

capture_wear_reference.name: capture_wear_reference
capture_wear_reference.description:
Save the actual Dress-up body and garment BakeMesh geometry for fitting diagnostics.

Pick the item and mesh names from get_wear_snapshot. The artifact carries
original positions, skin weights, bindposes and current bone matrices, so
a fit can be inverted without editing the body. By default it records the
stopped edit pose; preview=true requires running native playback and
records the synthesized body and garment in the same pose. With
include_base_meshes it also stores the base Body/Face/Hair skin and bones,
plus a separate Foot mesh when the model has one; base_mesh_names narrows
that to Body plus Foot/Face/Hair. A unique JSON file under saves/ is
written; geometry is not edited and no VRM is produced.

inspect_wear_fit_context.name: inspect_wear_fit_context
inspect_wear_fit_context.description:
Measure the base anatomy and the wearable geometry together in one native pose.

Returns world bounds, bone-registration offsets, bidirectional sampled
exact surface distances and inward-ray thickness estimates. The raw JSON
keeps original and posed vertices, normals, topology, UVs, weights and the
actual bone matrices, and a static diagnostic GLB is written with anatomy
and garment materials kept distinct. Take item and mesh ids from a fresh
get_wear_snapshot. Optional target_mesh_name (also present in mesh_names)
measures other parts against that garment, for example a tail or bow against
the main dress surface. preview=true requires active native playback.
Unsigned distances and intentional openings do not certify penetration.

sample_wear_preview_rig.name: sample_wear_preview_rig
sample_wear_preview_rig.description:
Read the current synthesized preview rig: bone world matrices, local TRS and ancestry.

Requires active native preview and a fresh wear token. Pair it with a held
pose for deterministic sampling. Poses are not modified and no animation is
exported.

list_wear_preview_clips.name: list_wear_preview_clips
list_wear_preview_clips.description:
List the allowlisted native body motions and poses with session-local ids.

Ids are valid for this session only; nothing is exported as an asset.

select_wear_preview_clip.name: select_wear_preview_clip
select_wear_preview_clip.description:
Choose a native motion or pose for the first Dress-up preview segment.

Start and stop the default preview once so its timeline exists. Requires
stopped playback and an id from a fresh list. The clip is cloned in memory
and does not modify the model; null restores the default. Restore the
default before saving or opening a model. No animation asset is written
into XWear/XRoid.

hold_wear_preview_pose.name: hold_wear_preview_pose
hold_wear_preview_pose.description:
Pause a selected native clip at a given time for repeatable contact tests.

Select a listed clip and start playback first; the time lies within that
clip's first timeline segment. The player strips the managed Pause/Evaluate
wrappers and checks the registered engine bindings before using them. Spring
physics can keep running, so measure actual drift with a motion capture.
Follow with capture_wear_reference(preview=true), then stop the preview and
restore the default clip before saving. Session-only.

capture_wear_motion.name: capture_wear_motion
capture_wear_motion.description:
Save consecutive preview images together with measured skeleton transforms.

The view also accepts REGION_ANGLE (body/face/head/upper/legs/feet with
front/back/left/right/three_quarter_left/three_quarter_right), with sides
observed from the front. Start playback explicitly first. Frames come from
the actual preview animator root with fixed framing and frame ids, and
playback keeps running afterwards: stop it before fitting or saving.
Movement and spring rotations are observations, not a collision clearance.

import_xwear.name: import_xwear
import_xwear.description:
Import a .xwear and return verified new item ids.

Attached sessions also accept an absolute input path; otherwise use lab saves/.

Nothing is fitted automatically and no body geometry is deleted. Fit-alert
options changed in the target profile are restored afterwards. Relist
with the new wear token.

set_wear_fit.name: set_wear_fit
set_wear_fit.description:
Set the native vertical and depth fit for one item and read the values back.

Stop animation first. The 0..2 range matches the sliders this project has
tested. A successful write says nothing about collision-free clothing:
inspect appearance and movement separately.

set_wear_animation.name: set_wear_animation
set_wear_animation.description: Start or stop the built-in preview idempotently, without desktop input.

pose_wear_preview_legs.name: pose_wear_preview_legs
pose_wear_preview_legs.description:
Freeze a selected clip and rotate both legs and feet inward on the preview clone.

The rotation is world-Y yaw, so the existing heel pitch is preserved. Foot
yaw is the total offset and is not added to the upper-leg yaw. This is a
session-only sampled pose, not continuous animation and not a saved
.vroidpose or XRoid pose. Stopping or re-selecting restores the offsets and
the source edit rig is untouched. The call needs the unique native J_Bip leg
rig and rejects anything else before rotating.

save_wear_project.name: save_wear_project
save_wear_project.description:
Save the assembly as a new XRoid archive without overwriting.

Attached sessions accept absolute paths in existing directories;
otherwise use a filename under lab saves/.

Requires stopped animation. The archive is verified and its hash returned.
A successful save proves persistence, not VRM or Godot readiness.

list_parameters.name: list_parameters
list_parameters.description:
List typed native controls with their values, units, ranges and options.

Hair needs a category and a node scope, accessories an instance scope, and
expressions may take an expression id as scope. Colors are RGBA in 0..1.
Clothing accepts a native category such as Tops, Bottoms, InnerTop or Shoes
to filter shape sliders before pagination. Omit category to list the whole outfit.
Read every next_offset page before concluding a control is missing. The
general domain covers outline, rim light, shading, gaze limits and spring
amplitude. Shape controls add semantic_key/group/bindings and a
translation_key; `name` is an exact-key English correction while `label`
stays native. Missing bindings are reported instead of guessed, and a
semantic key may repeat across controls and is never a write id. Colors add
native_value, mixed, color_bindings, shared_groups, alias_of and
affected_parameter_ids; a mixed aggregate such as BothEyes has a null value,
so use the separate side ids. Left and right follow the native UI controls,
which can be the opposite of the raw binding key names.

set_parameters.name: set_parameters
set_parameters.description:
Write 1-64 typed parameters taken from a fresh list_parameters result.

Every value is validated before anything is written, and native history can
undo the batch. Value shapes: curve [x,y] control points, quaternion
[x,y,z,w], vector [x,y,z], color [r,g,b,a]. Hair needs category and node
scope, accessories an instance scope. A native error can leave a partial
batch, so inspect ok/applied/error. Changing a preset or the hair structure
means relisting. Color batches reject overlapping targets (BothEyes together
with one eye, or a duplicated shared alias) while separate eyes may be set in
one call; writing BothEyes unifies them. Color results include settled
affected_parameters and a per-write verification from each binding.

list_presets.name: list_presets
list_presets.description:
Search native preset IDs/resources; owned-only by default, locked metadata is read-only.

The separate catalog field pages the all-category PlayFab metadata using
offset/limit and its own total/next_offset/complete flags. Catalog-only IDs
are nonselectable; resource-derived categories are annotations, not UI IDs.

preview_presets.name: preview_presets
preview_presets.description:
Return native thumbnails for 1-6 distinct ids from a fresh preset list.

Needs the model token from list_face_params. The response is a manifest plus
inline PNGs keyed by preset_id and name, in the requested order. Nothing is
applied, edited or saved. Empty option lists and unavailable previews appear
as per-item errors; unknown ids and a stale token reject the whole request.
The images are the presets' own thumbnails, not their fit on this character.

apply_preset.name: apply_preset
apply_preset.description:
Apply owned presets; optional native preservation verifies exact compatible color paths.

Preservation supports simple built-in replacements only, refuses clear/custom/set
options, and reports incompatible/unverified material coverage explicitly.

list_face_params.name: list_face_params
list_face_params.description: List the UI face sliders with labels, ranges, current values, aliases and the model token.

set_face_params.name: set_face_params
set_face_params.description:
Write 1-64 face sliders after validating every value and rejecting duplicate aliases.

Only the model behind expected_model may change. A native failure can leave a
partial batch, so read `applied` and `error` before continuing.

list_body_params.name: list_body_params
list_body_params.description: List the body proportions, height and limb sliders with ranges, values and the model token.

set_body_params.name: set_body_params
set_body_params.description: Write 1-64 body parameters from a fresh list_body_params result through native history.

list_clothing_params.name: list_clothing_params
list_clothing_params.description: List the shape sliders of the garments currently worn; ids change with the garment.

set_clothing_params.name: set_clothing_params
set_clothing_params.description: Write garment shape sliders from a fresh list_clothing_params result.

list_hair_presets.name: list_hair_presets
list_hair_presets.description: List owned hairstyles and hair parts with stable ids, pagination and English names.

apply_hair_preset.name: apply_hair_preset
apply_hair_preset.description: Apply an owned hairstyle or hair part; native history can undo it.

list_clothing_presets.name: list_clothing_presets
list_clothing_presets.description: List owned outfits, tops, bottoms, shoes and the other clothing categories.

apply_clothing_preset.name: apply_clothing_preset
apply_clothing_preset.description: Apply a clothing preset; it may replace conflicting garments, so relist the sliders afterwards.

list_shoe_templates.name: list_shoe_templates
list_shoe_templates.description: List the native shoe construction templates, including high heels, without changing the model.

add_shoe_template.name: add_shoe_template
add_shoe_template.description:
Create native shoes from a freshly listed template.

Requires that no native Shoes group exists yet, and never retries an
uncertain change.

get_height.name: get_height
get_height.description:
Read the current native height as live_centimeters.

Use live_centimeters (GetBodyHeight) for calibration and save/reopen
comparisons. centimeters and label are cached UI values and may lag;
their difference is not evidence of lost saved scale.

set_height.name: set_height
set_height.description:
Scale the whole body to a measured centimeter target and verify it within tolerance.

Relative proportions are preserved. The reachable range depends on the model;
when the solver does not converge the initial scale is restored, and a native
error means the current state must be inspected. Solver steps go through
native history. Hair and other proportions affect the measured height, so
call this after styling.

undo.name: undo
undo.description: Undo native history; the response returns face parameters, so relist other areas to inspect them.

redo.name: redo
redo.description: Redo native history; the response returns face parameters, so relist other areas to inspect them.

save_as.name: save_as
save_as.description:
Save a new .vroid copy; an existing file is never overwritten.

In an attached window this makes a copy and preserves the original
character file association and unsaved flag; it does not save in place.
Attached windows accept absolute paths in existing directories; plain
filenames and copy sessions use lab saves/.

open_character.name: open_character
open_character.description:
Open a .vroid in ordinary editing, using a lab filename or an attached absolute path.

Requires discard_unsaved=true and replaces the current character. Save
any work first; the opened file becomes the window's associated file.

save_character.name: save_character
save_character.description:
Save the attached character over its associated .vroid using native SaveSync.

First preserves the original bytes in a new lab backup. Requires an
existing associated file; untitled characters must use save_character_as first.
Failure is uncertain: inspect the original and backup before another save.

new_character.name: new_character
new_character.description:
Replace the attached ordinary character through the native new-character transition.

Requires discard_unsaved=true. Save current work before replacement.

save_character_as.name: save_character_as
save_character_as.description:
Save the attached character to a new .vroid and associate the window with it.

Accepts an absolute path in an existing directory, or a lab saves filename.
Never overwrites. If the character changes before association, inspect the
new file and window before retrying.

list_hair_groups.name: list_hair_groups
list_hair_groups.description:
List exact groups, concrete type and control-point polyline statistics.

Optional category selects one of the seven hair parts; omission scans all.
Lengths use native control-point coordinates without guide transforms.
They are independent of procedural Length and rendered spline length.

set_procedural_hair.name: set_procedural_hair
set_procedural_hair.description:
Set exact native procedural Length/HairCount controls within live UI ranges.

At least one value is required. Available on the admitted pixiv-signed
2.16.0 standalone and pixiv-signed 2.14.0 builds. The upstream 2.14.0
descriptor and the unadmitted Steam 2.16.0 hash refuse this write.
Existing exact native VM controls supply live ranges and setters. Other
paths use verified native managed modifiers and static native UI bounds,
without creating a property or JS-owned history delegate. Each scalar is
settled and read back before the next write. Configured Length has native
parameter units, separate from measured control-point geometry.

scale_brush_hair.name: scale_brush_hair
scale_brush_hair.description:
Scale all nonroot brush-group points about each strand's own root.

Factor must be finite in (0,10]. Normal, UV, guide and material are preserved.
Each moved point creates one native history command. Partial/uncertain
receipts identify completed points; never blindly retry those operations.

clone_brush_hair.name: clone_brush_hair
clone_brush_hair.description:
Clone a whole brush group, then offset every cloned point including roots.

Finite XYZ offset uses native control-point coordinates, without guide or
world conversion. Returns unique new group/strand IDs, completed native
command calls and verified geometry counts. Merged undo-entry counts are
unknown. Ambiguous or partial results must not be retried blindly.

list_hair_nodes.name: list_hair_nodes
list_hair_nodes.description:
List the groups and strands of one hair category.

Categories: HairFront, HairBack, AllHair, HairTied, HairSideburns, HairAhoge
and HairHanege. A returned id is the scope for
list_parameters(domain='hair', category=...).

list_hair_bone_groups.name: list_hair_bone_groups
list_hair_bone_groups.description:
List the hair physics groups.

list_parameters(domain='hair_bones', category=...) exposes bone count, root
rate, stiffness, gravity and radius for them.

generate_hair_bones.name: generate_hair_bones
generate_hair_bones.description:
Generate native hair bone groups from the hair_bones/generation parameters.

Existing grouping can be replaced. Native history can undo it.

edit_hair_structure.name: edit_hair_structure
edit_hair_structure.description:
Create or remove a hair node.

add_procedural creates a procedural group, add_brush creates a hand-drawn
brush group guide, and remove deletes the group or strand identified by
node_id. Native history can undo it. Hand-drawn strand points are then edited
with move_hair_strand_point; there is no freehand pen input. Every group id
is returned so a freshly added node can be found from list_hair_nodes.

list_hair_strand_points.name: list_hair_strand_points
list_hair_strand_points.description:
List the 3D spine control points of one hand-drawn strand.

Each entry carries index, point, normal and UV. Read-only. The node id must
be a strand from list_hair_nodes, not a group.

move_hair_strand_point.name: move_hair_strand_point
move_hair_strand_point.description:
Move one control point of a hand-drawn strand (brush strands only).

point and normal are local-space XYZ floats and uv is a UV pair. Native
history can undo it. Both the command result and the re-read control point
are returned; read the strand again with list_hair_strand_points.

list_hair_color_elements.name: list_hair_color_elements
list_hair_color_elements.description:
List the editable COLOR elements found in the model's transferable groups.

Each entry reports the owning group key, the element key and the transferable
id, together with the candidate element keys. Use a group key as the address
argument of set_hair_color. Read-only.

set_hair_color.name: set_hair_color
set_hair_color.description:
Write hair colour elements as RGBA floats in 0..1.

Use a transferable-group key from list_hair_color_elements as the address.
Before and after values are returned per change and native history can undo
the write. A successful write is not proof that the rendered colour changed:
check the image. For this build the per-group `Level1BaseHair_*` channels read
back but do not drive the visible hand-drawn render; global hair colour is
`set_parameters(domain='colors', id='colors/Hair/All')`.

duplicate_hair_strand.name: duplicate_hair_strand
duplicate_hair_strand.description:
Duplicate one hand-drawn strand inside its group, which builds hair layering.

Brush strands only. Native history can undo it. The added node ids are
returned so the copy can be edited straight away.

list_hair_materials.name: list_hair_materials
list_hair_materials.description:
List the shared hair materials with their ids and main colours.

The list comes from the live material thumbnail collection.

set_hair_material.name: set_hair_material
set_hair_material.description:
Assign a shared hair material to one group or hand-drawn strand.

Take the id from list_hair_materials. Native history can undo it. The
material id is read back after the write; `applied: false` means the
read-back differs from the request.

inspect_native_api.name: inspect_native_api
inspect_native_api.description:
List one managed class's declared methods (with parameter and return types) and typed fields.

A read-only discovery aid for extending this tool set; caller-supplied code is
never executed. Pass a substring filter to bound the output, which is capped
at 400 methods and 200 fields.

search_native_classes.name: search_native_classes
search_native_classes.description:
List full class names in one managed assembly whose name contains a substring.

The substring needs at least three characters and the result is capped at 100
matches. Read-only: use it to find the exact name for inspect_native_api.

list_accessory_templates.name: list_accessory_templates
list_accessory_templates.description: List the accessory templates: glasses, animal ears, tails and hats.

list_accessories.name: list_accessories
list_accessories.description: List the worn accessory instance ids; an id is the scope for accessory parameters.

edit_accessories.name: edit_accessories
edit_accessories.description:
Add a template, or remove or duplicate a worn accessory.

Relist the instances and their parameters afterwards.

list_expressions.name: list_expressions
list_expressions.description: List expression ids; their definition weights are under list_parameters(domain='expressions', scope=id).

set_preview_mode.name: set_preview_mode
set_preview_mode.description:
Enter native photo preview or return to model editing.

Photo parameters are session-only and are not saved into .vroid. Use
list_parameters(domain='photo') for poses, hand poses, lighting, wind,
effects and gaze. Return to edit before editing or saving the character.
No mouse or keyboard automation is involved.

set_photo_camera.name: set_photo_camera
set_photo_camera.description: Set the photo camera position and look-at target as [x,y,z] metres, then screenshot(view='photo').

preview_expression.name: preview_expression
preview_expression.description:
Preview an expression by id; null clears the visual preview.

Expression weights are not modified.

capture_body_reference.name: capture_body_reference
capture_body_reference.description:
Save the current body and face geometry, skeleton and skin weights for clothing fitting.

Uses a fresh model token. The native body is not changed; one uniquely named
JSON artifact is written under this lab's saves/. Edit-pose vertices, Unity
coordinates and bone matrices are stated explicitly. No textures, hair,
clothing or VRM export.

screenshot.name: screenshot
screenshot.description:
Return one native PNG; use the photo view for a posed preview.

Legacy views are front/side/back/three_quarter plus the full_ variants.
Regional views are REGION_ANGLE with REGION in
body/face/head/upper/legs/feet and ANGLE in
front/back/left/right/three_quarter_left/three_quarter_right (for example
face_left); left and right are observer sides seen from the front, and
regional views need edit mode. Quality: legacy is a single sample, balanced
adds 4x MSAA, high adds 4x MSAA with a 2x render scale. Internal rendering is
capped at 8M pixels while the output stays within 256..2048, and the GPU may
reduce MSAA. Use capture_review when the effective quality metadata matters.
Optional paired width/height are 256..2048; MSAA accepts 1/2/4 and SSAA
accepts 1/2/3. current_editor preserves the active edit camera pose and fits
its projected view without crop or changed subject proportions. clean=False
accepts the default view or current_editor and default render
arguments; it reads Unity's actual application framebuffer at end of frame,
including UI, with native dimensions/quality. It never focuses the desktop
and never falls back between capture modes. Photo settings are restored.
Clean cameras exclude native auxiliary guide layers without changing UI
selection. Fixed/regional/current-editor clones preserve selected hair on
its native Outline layer. Bone material overrides must be cleared manually;
live photo capture also requires hair selection to be cleared. An unavailable
guide-isolation binding fails explicitly before render or selection changes.

screenshot_metadata.name: screenshot_metadata
screenshot_metadata.description:
Return a screenshot plus effective dimensions, quality, framing and provenance.

Uses the same bounded capture contract as screenshot; base64 is carried only
by the image block. Native/visual acceptance is separate from metadata.

editor_camera.name: editor_camera
editor_camera.description:
Read/change the current model's edit camera; photo camera is separate.

angles and rotate use [x,y] degrees (bounded +/-36000). Zoom delta and pan
[x,y] are native input deltas (+/-1000), with no physical-unit conversion.
custom requires position/center vectors (+/-10000 native coordinates).
mode accepts Front/Right/Top/Reverse/RotateUp/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateDown.
projection toggles the actual projection. Animated modes poll to completion.
Saved model/history is unchanged. Multi-camera ambiguity is refused.
Get is read-only; known prewrite rejections return ok=False without leaving
an edit receipt. Unknown or post-invocation failures retain uncertainty.

face_preview.name: face_preview
face_preview.description:
List/filter or temporarily set raw current-face blendshape weights (0..100).

Exact case-insensitive name wins; suffix matches must be unique. reset zeros
the scoped face only; restore reapplies the original snapshot with readback.
Renderer/mesh identity and weights are checked at capture. Rebuilds/animation
can replace preview state. Does not modify saved expression definitions.
Successful restore releases tracking; the next preview snapshots its new
baseline. Listing is read-only. Known prewrite refusal is distinguishable
from an uncertain/partial invocation and never requires a blind retry.

capture_review.name: capture_review
capture_review.description:
Capture 1-6 native views for visual inspection and save the PNGs plus numeric state.

Defaults to front, three_quarter, full_front and full_back, and requires edit
mode. REGION_ANGLE views work as documented for screenshot; one regional batch
shares its measured bounds, and a baseline from the same model locks those
bounds while another model gets fresh ones. The response carries the images,
their paths, the model height, the capture id and a visual checklist. There is
an option to return only the manifest and local paths (include_images=false).
no OCR, no click automation, no beauty scoring and no automatic collision
verdict. Passing baseline_id from an earlier capture with the same views and
size yields before/after images and parameter differences for face, body,
clothing and colour; hair geometry changes still need visual inspection, and a
different model token is called out explicitly. The character is not edited or
saved: only review artifacts are written and the editor guides are hidden.

list_parts.name: list_parts
list_parts.description:
List active native model parts with resource IDs and custom/modified flags.

Includes registered closet custom_items and savable_types. Pass the fresh
model_token; listed built-in or registered custom IDs work with replace_part.

replace_part.name: replace_part
replace_part.description:
Replace one built-in or registered closet part using the native loader.

Registered custom IDs use native custom-item import. Unknown or old-version
IDs are refused. Relist parts and parameters after replacement.
Verified copies wait for native PNG callbacks before texture entry.
Sessions without that decoder keep the conservative cold-reopen guard.

save_custom_items.name: save_custom_items
save_custom_items.description:
Save worn parts as new custom items in the current VRoid profile's closet.

types selects unique names from list_parts savable_types; None saves all.
Verifies new files, ZIP integrity, metadata and native closet registration.
Existing items are never overwritten. Attached mode uses that real
window's profile and preserves its character file association/dirty flag.
Partial/uncertain saves are not rolled back; inspect files before retrying.

export_vrm.name: export_vrm
export_vrm.description:
Export the ordinary edit model using its native VRM metadata and settings.

version 0 exports VRM 0.x, version 1 exports VRM 1.0. A new filename is
written under lab/saves; existing files are refused. The model's native
VRM title/name must be set in the model or supplied as title. Optional
title/author override only the exported metadata; other permissions use
the model's own settings. model_version overrides only the exported version.
Omitted options keep observed native settings. A supplied object overlays
those settings: delete_transparent, hair_cross_section, combine_hair are
booleans; hair_smoothness, hair, face, body, outfit, hair_bones are integer
sliders 0..100; material_mode, texture_mode, atlas_resolution are native
choice indices from get_vrm_export_options. Returns requested/effective
settings and warnings if VRoid refuses a combination after one reapply.
Fresh screen rebuilds are required. leave=None preserves the pre-call
screen ownership; explicit True/False closes/keeps the export screen safely.
Uncertain export work retains native handles and forbids retry/navigation.
Container/reference checks do not establish visual or engine acceptance.

get_vrm_export_options.name: get_vrm_export_options

list_groups.name: list_groups
list_groups.description: List exact active/leaf/stored group identities, revisions and native removal evidence.

list_group_parameters.name: list_group_parameters
list_group_parameters.description:
List exact typed/raw/item bindings, native units and unsupported-write reasons.

Relist after any preset/topology change. IDs bind model/group revisions;
semantic keys and translated labels are not write addresses. Audited
garment item blendshape paths use 0..100 native units. Other raw scalars
require exact VM metadata for an editable control.

set_group_parameters.name: set_group_parameters
set_group_parameters.description:
Write exact {id,type,units,value} rows from a fresh group parameter list.

Every row validates before the first native command. Batches can require
multiple undo steps; partial errors include actual settled readback.

list_sections.name: list_sections
list_sections.description: List group-bound sections; unknown native types stay explicitly unclassified.

list_categories.name: list_categories
list_categories.description: List exact native group categories and every matching group ID.

enter_category.name: enter_category
enter_category.description: Return unambiguous group-bound controls; this facade does not navigate the UI.

remove_items.name: remove_items
remove_items.description:
Remove an exact group ID/full type with native clear evidence and per-group readback.

Mandatory/unknown-removability groups are refused before any removal.
Timeout/cancellation leaves the session uncertain; do not blindly retry.

apply_custom_item.name: apply_custom_item
apply_custom_item.description:
Apply a validated current-format file matching an already registered closet item.

Copy paths stay in the lab input policy; attached paths may be absolute.
A project copy needs exact byte/metadata identity with the registered file.
No registry entries or profile files are created. Native load/deserialization
and identity checks precede selection. Native in-memory normalization
must preserve root/type/resource/revision; source bytes are never rewritten.

apply_custom_item_by_key.name: apply_custom_item_by_key
apply_custom_item_by_key.description:
Apply a current custom key from search_preset_cache to the expected active model.

Both session modes require the same live registered file, revisions and bytes.

set_body_size.name: set_body_size
set_body_size.description:
Solve silhouette FigureHeight/FigureSlender with live native height feedback.

F00/M00 requires actual editable gender-specific paired bindings. Global
proportional scale is zeroed; set_height keeps its existing solver. Weight
applies the source BMI/waist heuristic, never measured mass. Failures restore
all snapshotted pairs when native state is known, reporting restoration errors.

export_renderer_texture.name: export_renderer_texture
export_renderer_texture.description: Export the actual rendered main texture. Generated atlas UV coordinates may differ from editable canvas UV; do not infer an editing address from shared material identity alone.

pick_texture_uv.name: pick_texture_uv
pick_texture_uv.description: Ray-pick current baked renderer geometry, returning exact triangle, barycentric UV, material/texture slot and top-left pixel coordinates. Coincident hits are reported separately.

export_nail_uv_map.name: export_nail_uv_map
export_nail_uv_map.description: Discover ten paired distal-bone nail caps from actual Hand geometry; export 10 per-finger masks plus a colored diagnostic overlay. This is not a toenail tool. Ambiguous topology or UV sharing is rejected. Visual verification is required.

capture_texture_detail.name: capture_texture_detail
capture_texture_detail.description: Render a fixed native closeup at measured world coordinates. Optional eye_closure uses verified native close shapes only during Render and restores original weights with readback. Camera resources are released; no expression definitions, textures or saved model are changed.

export_makeup_region_mask.name: export_makeup_region_mask
export_makeup_region_mask.description: Export a model/image-bound paint mask. Cheek/MouthLine/Eyebrow use the reference alpha footprint; Eyelid uses canvas UV triangles. FaceSkin requires area='under_eye': map a conservative skin strip from actual paired eye-hole boundaries, with shadow/highlight canvas guides. No fixed UV boxes; ambiguous face topology or UV sharing is rejected. No painting or saving.

preview_makeup_marks.name: preview_makeup_marks
preview_makeup_marks.description: Render soft/hard elliptical stamps or connected brush strokes to a transparent PNG, strictly clipped to a fresh measured mask. Coordinates are normalized top-left canvas x/y, not Unity UV. Creates review artifacts, no model changes.

points.description: Normalized canvas x/y in 0..1, origin top-left; stamp: one point, stroke: at least two.
points.title: Points

radius.description: Brush minor radius as a fraction of the shorter image side.
radius.title: Radius

hardness.description: 0: fully feathered; 1: hard edge with pixel antialiasing.
hardness.title: Hardness

mirror_x.description: Reflect points and brush rotation about the canvas center; does not infer anatomical left/right.
mirror_x.title: Mirror X

paint_makeup_marks.name: paint_makeup_marks
paint_makeup_marks.description: Paint bounded stamps/strokes as a NEW native overlay layer above existing layers. Validates mask/source/model/current canvas before writes. Uses generated raster PNG and native layer history, not simulated mouse drawing. Does not save. Bake colors when opening the region if native recoloring would swallow RGB; verify visible output separately.

points.description: Normalized canvas x/y in 0..1, origin top-left; stamp: one point, stroke: at least two.
points.title: Points

radius.description: Brush minor radius as a fraction of the shorter image side.
radius.title: Radius

hardness.description: 0: fully feathered; 1: hard edge with pixel antialiasing.
hardness.title: Hardness

mirror_x.description: Reflect points and brush rotation about the canvas center; does not infer anatomical left/right.
mirror_x.title: Mirror X

export_body_paint_mask.name: export_body_paint_mask
export_body_paint_mask.description: Measure the open BodySkin canvas from its UV triangles. Pixels outside those triangles stay unpaintable. Shared pixels more than 2 cm apart are reported and cannot be edited as independent left and right sides. Does not paint or save.

preview_body_marks.name: preview_body_marks
preview_body_marks.description: Preview stamps or strokes clipped to a BodySkin UV mask. mirror_x reflects the canvas and does not create independent sides when UV is shared. No model change.

points.description: Normalized canvas x/y in 0..1, origin top-left; stamp: one point, stroke: at least two.
points.title: Points

radius.description: Brush minor radius as a fraction of the shorter image side.
radius.title: Radius

hardness.description: 0: fully feathered; 1: hard edge with pixel antialiasing.
hardness.title: Hardness

mirror_x.description: Reflect points and brush rotation about the canvas center; does not infer anatomical left/right.
mirror_x.title: Mirror X

paint_body_marks.name: paint_body_marks
paint_body_marks.description: Import that clipped preview as a new native layer. Does not save.

points.description: Normalized canvas x/y in 0..1, origin top-left; stamp: one point, stroke: at least two.
points.title: Points

radius.description: Brush minor radius as a fraction of the shorter image side.
radius.title: Radius

hardness.description: 0: fully feathered; 1: hard edge with pixel antialiasing.
hardness.title: Hardness

mirror_x.description: Reflect points and brush rotation about the canvas center; does not infer anatomical left/right.
mirror_x.title: Mirror X

preview_body_decal.name: preview_body_decal
preview_body_decal.description: Place one PNG from lab saves onto the BodySkin mask. Scale is the source width divided by the shorter canvas side. Rotation is clockwise degrees about the center in top-left canvas space. Source alpha is copied. An opaque pixel outside the mask is rejected. The source file is not modified.

paint_body_decal.name: paint_body_decal
paint_body_decal.description: Import the fitted decal as a new native layer. Does not save or rewrite the source PNG.

preview_freckles.name: preview_freckles
preview_freckles.description: Scatter freckles inside a Cheek or BodySkin mask. The same seed repeats the same placement. Eye, lip and lash masks are refused. No model change.

paint_freckles.name: paint_freckles
paint_freckles.description: Import the seeded freckle preview as a new native layer. Does not save.

preview_moles.name: preview_moles
preview_moles.description: Preview point marks inside a Cheek, under-eye FaceSkin, or BodySkin mask. A point outside the mask is rejected. No model change.

paint_moles.name: paint_moles
paint_moles.description: Import the mole preview as a new native layer. Does not save.

inspect_toenail_targets.name: inspect_toenail_targets
inspect_toenail_targets.description: Measure isolated Foot caps weighted only to toe bones. This does not call the ten-finger nail tool. If the toes are not a separable cap, the result says why and contains no guessed pixels.

preview_toenail_color.name: preview_toenail_color
preview_toenail_color.description: Color measured toenail caps only. Refuses when inspection did not prove separable caps. Does not recolor surrounding foot skin and does not change the model.

paint_toenail_color.name: paint_toenail_color
paint_toenail_color.description: Import that toenail preview as a new native layer. Does not save. Hand nails are unchanged.

set_texture_layer_state.name: set_texture_layer_state
set_texture_layer_state.description: Change an EXISTING raster layer's visibility/opacity in its matching open native canvas. Pass state_sha256 from a fresh list_texture_layers result; stale metadata is rejected again on the native write boundary. Preserves PNG pixels, other layers and order. Native history supports Undo/Redo; no-op returns zero commands. Does not save or retry partial native errors.

rename_texture_layer.name: rename_texture_layer
rename_texture_layer.description:
Rename one existing raster layer in its matching open canvas.

Pass its fresh state_sha256. Preserves pixels, order and other layers.
Native Undo/Redo is supported; an unchanged name creates no command.
Names must contain visible text and no control characters. Does not save.

delete_texture_layer.name: delete_texture_layer
delete_texture_layer.description:
Delete one raster layer through native history in its matching open canvas.

Requires fresh layer and image stack hashes from list_texture_layers.
Refuses the image's last raster layer. Preserves other layers and order;
native Undo restores the deleted layer and pixels. Does not save or retry.

reorder_texture_layers.name: reorder_texture_layers
reorder_texture_layers.description:
Set one editable image's full raster-layer order in the matching open canvas.

Use image_id and stack_sha256 from list_texture_layers.images. Supply
exactly its current layer_ids in the desired bottom-to-top order;
omissions, duplicates and layers from another image are refused.
One native history command; unchanged order is a no-op. Does not save.

set_texture_layer_blend.name: set_texture_layer_blend
set_texture_layer_blend.description:
Set one raster layer's native blend mode in its matching open canvas.

Take an exact id from list_texture_layers.composition_modes and pass a
fresh layer state hash. Preserves source PNG pixels; composition changes.
Native Undo/Redo supported; same mode creates no command. Does not save.

inspect_texture_renderers.name: inspect_texture_renderers
inspect_texture_renderers.description: Read actual Face/Body/Hand/Foot material slots, texture identities and UV transforms. Identical instance IDs in one sample prove texture sharing.

list_texture_regions.name: list_texture_regions
list_texture_regions.description: List texture regions and images. A non-null editor_mode identifies a supported native editor. UV mapping is reported separately.

list_texture_layers.name: list_texture_layers
list_texture_layers.description: List native raster layers, state_sha256 tokens, per-image layer_ids/stack_sha256 and supported composition_modes. Keep returned enumeration order when editing a stack; relist after Undo/Redo, import or reopening. Native folder editing is not exposed.

export_texture_layer.name: export_texture_layer
export_texture_layer.description: Export the real native raster layer PNG into this lab's reviews directory.

open_texture_editor.name: open_texture_editor
open_texture_editor.description: Open and verify the native texture editor for a listed region. For Tops, InnerTop, Bottoms, ArmAccessory and Shoes, leave bake_colors false. Optional color baking allows authored RGB to survive skin recoloring. Does not save the model.

list_clothing_templates.name: list_clothing_templates
list_clothing_templates.description:
List the templates in VRoid's Add Template dialog for an open clothing canvas.

The region must match the open texture editor. Optional category filters
using an ID from categories. Template IDs come from this list, not the
ordinary clothing preset catalog. The dialog closes without a model edit.

add_clothing_template.name: add_clothing_template
add_clothing_template.description:
Add a native clothing template to the matching open texture canvas.

Pass a template ID from list_clothing_templates. VRoid overlays the new
garment on the existing one. Check ok and use added_images to address the
new garment's texture. If ok is false, inspect the canvas before making
any further edits. Close the texture editor before saving the model.

inspect_texture_canvas.name: inspect_texture_canvas
inspect_texture_canvas.description:
Read active canvas image paths and their actual referring native texture paths.

Use compact=true for editing. It returns the matching region and each
image's label, full import image_id, and template label when available.
The default includes the existing detailed native diagnostics.

import_texture_layer.name: import_texture_layer
import_texture_layer.description: Add a PNG from this lab's saves directory above existing layers in the matching open canvas. Preserves existing layers; reports exact history command count including optional moves. Verify pixels, visible color and save/reopen separately.

inspect_hair_materials.name: inspect_hair_materials
inspect_hair_materials.description:
Read active shared hair material channels and exact image regions.

Base overlay IDs are global and deduplicated. Their exact readback is
unavailable; aggregate hair colors are never substituted as evidence.

begin_clothing_edit.name: begin_clothing_edit
begin_clothing_edit.description:
Convert an exact active garment to editable native textures through history.

Waits for native readiness and returns fresh image/layer identities.
screen_entered=false: conversion does not establish canvas navigation.
Does not save; native Undo/Redo requires separate supported-build testing.

begin_hair_edit.name: begin_hair_edit
begin_hair_edit.description:
Convert one active shared hair material and return fresh exact image regions.

Shared image ownership comes from native material sections. This does not
navigate to a canvas; screen_entered=false. Does not save or retry.

replace_texture_layer.name: replace_texture_layer
replace_texture_layer.description:
Replace an existing raster, preserving name/state/order, with one native history command.

Requires exact image/layer IDs, input PNG hash and current exported PNG
hash; optional state token adds caller metadata preconditions. RGBA8 PNG
dimensions must match. Rechecks actual pixels at native write boundary.
Returns actual before/after hashes; no canvas navigation or save implied.

recolor_texture_layer.name: recolor_texture_layer
recolor_texture_layer.description:
Recolor exact existing raster RGB with source multiply or luminance colorize math.

Alpha bytes are preserved, including transparent pixels. Strength zero
preserves input PNG bytes. Uses guarded native replacement/history and
returns actual readback hashes; visible appearance needs separate review.

set_hair_material_color.name: set_hair_material_color
set_hair_material_color.description:
Write one discovered exact shared material channel or global base:<id> overlay.

Ordinary material readback uses its actual section path. Global base IDs
have unavailable exact readback; known command completion is labelled
separately from verification. No getter proves visible appearance.

colorize.name: colorize
colorize.description:
Compose global|texture|both writes within one exact active group.

Exact optional material/layer filters restrict scope. Shared bindings and
rasters are deduplicated. Returns individual receipts and stops on native
uncertainty, with partial results and no synthetic rollback. Both can
compound tint and baked pixels; rendered color is not verified here.

close_texture_editor.name: close_texture_editor
close_texture_editor.description: Leave native texture editing through its own Exit; does not save the model.

export_texture_guide.name: export_texture_guide
export_texture_guide.description: Export the active native UV guide PNG. Open the correct cosmetics region first; does not paint or save the model.

export_texture_surface.name: export_texture_surface
export_texture_surface.description: Export the active canvas mesh, triangles, UVs and native bone identities with exact image addresses. This is not an automatic nail segmentation mask.

vroid_measure.name: vroid_measure
vroid_measure.description:
Read current owned model bounds/enabled renderer count and optional scoped humanoid landmarks.

Reports native height separately from renderer vertical extent and the
source's ground-dependent maxY*100 convention. Does not capture an image.

build_preset_thumbnails.name: build_preset_thumbnails
build_preset_thumbnails.description:
Strip native removable slots and capture tested resources in an explicitly disposable owned copy.

Saves a unique restoration snapshot first. Restores only when native
work and ownership remain known; returns a fresh token and restoration
evidence. Undo history, original dirty/file association and neutral
anatomy are not preserved guarantees. Failed rows are never published.

search_preset_cache.name: search_preset_cache
search_preset_cache.description:
Search offline with ALL query words and exact combined filters; never starts VRoid.

owned=None keeps either ownership; true/false is an independent exact
predicate applied before limit. include_locked controls usability only.

annotate_preset_cache.name: annotate_preset_cache
annotate_preset_cache.description: Annotate offline; manual label wins. Append tags/colors, or replace including empty lists.

sync_preset_cache.name: sync_preset_cache
sync_preset_cache.description:
Synchronize bounded full native selectable/catalog streams and observed registered custom items.

Requires a fresh model token. Partial custom observation preserves missing
records as unknown. Icons require fresh owned selectable identity, use
native-icon provenance and are bounded to 1..200 (default 50) per call.

preset_thumbnail.name: preset_thumbnail
preset_thumbnail.description: Read a verified offline PNG with actual situation/native-icon provenance; never starts VRoid.

get_preset_framing.name: get_preset_framing
get_preset_framing.description:
Read immutable category defaults plus local overrides without starting VRoid.

top/bottom are downward model-height fractions, half is horizontal
half-width/model-height (null=projected bounds), distance multiplies
region span, yaw is degrees. Full-body makes top/bottom/half inactive.

set_preset_framing.name: set_preset_framing
set_preset_framing.description:
Persist category override offline. clear_half=true selects full projected width.

Preserve requested regional fields for full-body, where capture must
contain all projected model-bound corners. 0<=top<bottom<=1,
0<half<=1, .1<=distance<=100, -360<=yaw<=360. Capture reports any
effective distance adjustment needed for full-body containment.

reset_preset_framing.name: reset_preset_framing
reset_preset_framing.description: Remove one/all local framing overrides offline, preserving committed defaults.

return_to_main_menu.name: return_to_main_menu
return_to_main_menu.description: Return the active edit model to its native menu. A dirty model requires explicit discard.

exit_vroid.name: exit_vroid
exit_vroid.description: Gracefully exit this exact edit session. An attached real window requires close_attached=true.

create_from_menu.name: create_from_menu
create_from_menu.description: Create a template in the same process using its current menu_token. Confirm an attached window.

open_from_menu.name: open_from_menu
open_from_menu.description: Open an existing lab saves filename or attached absolute .vroid using the current menu_token.

run_batch.name: run_batch
run_batch.description:
Run 1..200 ordered {tool,args} calls. Nontransactional. Indices are zero-based.

Validate all names/shapes first. Validate arguments and current model at each
call. executed includes failed attempted calls. Uncertain sessions stop immediately.

get_help.name: get_help
get_help.description: Read offline overview/session/batch/migration/tools or a registered tool's exact input schema.
